# Cougar athletics welcomed into ICCAC/NJCAA

Wednesday, October 23, 2024

"I’m thrilled that we were unanimously voted into the NJCAA and will also be competing members in Region 11 within the ICCAC,” Athletic Director Nick Weinmeister said.

Northeast Iowa Community College (NICC) received confirmation on Friday, Oct. 18, they had been accepted into the Iowa Community College Athletic Conference Region 11 (ICCAC) and the National Junior College Athletic Association (NJCAA).

The NJCAA is the governing body over junior college athletics, and serves over 60,000 student-athletes across the country and over 500 colleges. The ICCAC currently has 17 schools competing for conference titles in a variety of sports.

NICC announced in August that the school had added several new athletic programs to complement its currently existing Esports and sports shooting teams: baseball, dance, men's and women's cross country and softball.

Esports has been competing in the National Junior College Athletic Association Esports (NJCAAE) since 2022, while sports shooting has already been facing current ICCAC schools in their competitions.

“The NJCAA is pleased to welcome Northeast Iowa Community College to the association,” NJCAA Vice President of Membership & Development Chris Haley said. “Northeast Iowa is currently a member of NJCAAE and will now expand upon its sport offerings by joining the NJCAA and creating greater opportunities for student-athletes to compete at the two-year level.”

These new athletic programs will officially start in August 2025. They will then begin competing in Region 11 within the ICCAC and in the NJCAA.

"I’m thrilled that we were unanimously voted into the NJCAA and will also be competing members within the ICCAC,” Athletic Director Nick Weinmeister said. “Throughout the process, being affiliated with Region 11 and the NJCAA was always the goal, but until you get confirmation, you never know what's going to happen. This is the first big step to getting all of our new sports offerings off the ground, and now we know when they will begin."

Other teams in the ICCAC include Des Moines Area, Ellsworth, Hawkeye, Indian Hills, Iowa Central, Iowa Lakes, Iowa Western, Kirkwood, Marshalltown, Northeast, North Iowa Area, Scott, Southeastern, Southwestern and Western Iowa Tech Community Colleges (CC).

Stay up-to-date on all NICC Cougar Athletics at nicc.edu/athletics.

*All new members of the NJCAA are not postseason eligible in their first year of competition, per NJCAA by-laws. After year one, there are no limitations, and NICC would have full NJCAA membership status.*

# Virginia Reveals 2027 Baseball Schedule

Virginia unveiled its 55-game, 2027 baseball schedule on Friday, featuring 31 home games at Disharoon Park, 30 ACC contests and a season-opening trip to Globe Life Field in Arlington, Texas.

CHARLOTTESVILLE, Va. - Virginia unveiled its 55-game, 2027 baseball schedule on Monday, featuring 31 home games at Disharoon Park, 30 ACC contests and a season-opening trip to Globe Life Field in Arlington, Texas.

Virginia opens with TCU at the home of the Texas Rangers on Feb. 19 before a matchup with Arizona on Feb. 20. The Cavaliers wrap up their stay in the Lone Star State against Texas on Feb. 21. 

The home opener at Disharoon Park is scheduled for Feb. 23 against VMI while Virginia hosts Cornell (Feb. 26-28) and Bucknell (March 5-7) for a pair of non-conference series.

The Commonwealth Clash with Virginia Tech is set for March 23 at a location to be determined. --------------------------------------------------------------------------------

# NWAC Baseball: All 28 Teams, Real Rules, How to Get In

By Wayne Keeton | Updated September 20, 2026

Updated September 2026. Team list and regions checked against the NWAC baseball standings, eligibility from the NWAC eligibility requirements page, championship details from NWAC Championship Central.

You typed “NWAC baseball” into Google and got a standings page, a few college athletics sites, and nothing that explains what the NWAC is. Nobody told you which 28 schools play, what a coach can actually offer you, or how a player from Spokane or Salem ends up on one of those rosters.

This page does all of that. It is the only complete list of NWAC baseball programs on the web, sorted by region, with the scholarship cap, the eligibility rules, the championship format, and a direct path to every coaching staff.

Here is what you get, in order:

  * What the NWAC is, and how it differs from the NJCAA and the California junior colleges
  * Every NWAC baseball team for 2026, by region
## Every NWAC baseball team in 2026, by region

Twenty-eight teams played the 2026 NWAC baseball season. The conference groups them into four regions, and the region decides the conference schedule, the standings, and the first step of the playoff. Every team below is in the Uncommitted University coach directory, where “Northwest Athletic” in the search box brings up every NWAC staff on one list.
